selectionType

@Input()
selectionType: SelectionType
  • Defined in packages/angular/src/list/list-item/ai-list-item.component.ts:136

Indicates the editing style of the list item. If it is multi the list item will be rendered with a checkbox. If it is not given then the list item will not be editable, that is, you can't select it.
